documents.title: Versioned public contracts and reproducible producer delivery — implementation

tasks.label: Record immutable implementation input authority
tasks.outcome: Extend existing packaging provenance with a committed integration input snapshot containing relevant source and toolchain hashes, archive payload hashes and explicit schema versions. Preserve unrelated staged/working changes; publish no dirty implementation. Documentation and counterpart qualification receipts outside the input set must not recursively invalidate the runtime archive; relevant source/payload changes always do.

tasks.label: Deliver authenticated registration and operation negotiation schemas
tasks.outcome: Extend the single local contract authority with bounded version/capability negotiation, registration-use purpose, delegation/grant references, workflow claim/renew/settle operations and exact command correlation. Preserve old signed bytes and old-protocol refusals; no actor/trust boolean or generic shell input. Use a compatible extension only when old consumers cannot misread it, otherwise negotiate a new version.

tasks.label: Add authoring and choice contract authority
tasks.outcome: Publish a bounded desktop policy projection contract for verified principal/installation/policy digest, create/edit/clone/import operations, allowed provider/model/account/workspace/tool/automation/credential references and locked/constrained/user-editable field states. Define this versioned enterprise projection independently of Maestro private settings. Secrets and host paths are not choices or identity authority. Concrete Maestro settings vocabulary mapping belongs to MCOMP-07-02 and GCOMP-13-02/GCOMP-13-08 after MAESTRO-DESKTOP-CONTRACT-BUILD is published; it is not a prerequisite for this foundation contract. Preserve an explicit mapping_unavailable result until the authenticated runtime mapping exists. Review the existing three-file draft and its focused tests, finish only this foundation contract and its delivery, then allow subsequent packaging tasks to proceed.

tasks.label: Publish owned contract packaging entrypoints
tasks.outcome: Extend existing archive allowlist, exports and generated HTTP projections for the new contracts; preserve exact dependencies, SHA-256/SHA-512 and payload/input provenance. Emit consumer-readable protocol/features and immutable implementation snapshot identity without copying sibling source or private runtime state.

tasks.label: Repair archive fixtures for committed source validation
tasks.outcome: Replace the obsolete Git command double with disposable committed fixture repositories. Exercise the real shared snapshot authority while retaining the explicitly labeled pnpm JSON-pack double; verify immutable input identity, required exports, dirty input refusal and preserved digest-directory behavior. These unit fixtures do not qualify a real archive.

tasks.label: Correct application component metadata
tasks.outcome: Reuse isolated clean builds to package real endpoint/API/gateway entries, native ABI/platform fields, contracts archive digest and truthful supported producer versions. Make metadata use the schema the public consumer verifies; remove hardcoded unsupported adapter metadata only after a real matching producer exists. Do not introduce readiness flags.

tasks.label: Repair application archive fixtures and assert component metadata
tasks.outcome: Reuse the existing production archive harness with real committed fixture inputs and the shared snapshot authority. Keep child producers explicitly synthetic, verify component entries/versions/hashes, native ABI and absent-native status, contract digest/integrity and unchanged fail-closed cleanup. No fixture outcome qualifies a real producer or platform.

tasks.label: Produce bounded integration artifact receipts
tasks.outcome: Create one manifest producer composing existing contract/application packagers and source snapshots. Receipts bind immutable inputs, actual archives and capabilities, and remain outside Maestro runtime archive inputs to avoid mutual qualification cycles. Verify content-addressed directories rather than trusting a path or version string; no --allow-dirty/stale route to certifiable delivery.

tasks.label: Author public archive and protocol compatibility regressions
tasks.outcome: Add behavioral archive/schema tests for old-version refusal, forged authority fields, unknown operations, missing export/payload, altered digest and coordination-only receipt changes. Test meaningful source changes invalidate the correct artifact while documentation alone cannot cause a pin cycle.

tasks.label: Deliver the existing fail-closed adapter public export
tasks.outcome: Preserve and deliver the existing unsupported adapter facade and public export so committed archive consumers can load the declared API. Keep unsupported results and never load caller-supplied artifact paths; this is not the real Maestro mapping, which remains in GCOMP-03. Repair only the observed clean-snapshot missing export.

tasks.label: Deliver adapter refusal and non-execution regressions
tasks.outcome: Review and retain the existing seventeen adapter refusal cases, including every runtime-port operation, request correlation and supplied artifact paths/URLs/retries producing no effect. Run the complete runtime-adapter suite and public-export smoke with the pinned toolchain. This verifies the unavailable facade, not counterpart runtime support.

tasks.label: Verify and publish implementation inputs
tasks.outcome: Run the changed-module unit suites, type/build checks and public archive load/contract checks relevant to this phase. Fix failures through separate bounded IMPLEMENT/TEST continuations before retrying. Publish the actual clean implementation snapshot, payload/input hashes, public archives and commands/results in the BUILD receipt. This receipt supplies compiled inputs for the other owner; it grants no execution authority and proves no paired/native/provider support. Every paired, native and real-provider requirement remains in its separate qualification task.

documents.title: Versioned public contracts and reproducible producer delivery — qualification

tasks.label: Verify versioned public contracts and reproducible producer delivery
tasks.outcome: Run focused contracts/distribution tests, relevant strict compilation and existing isolated archivers on a reviewed committed input snapshot. Load exported schemas from the produced archive in plain Node, verify service entrypoints and native metadata, and emit MEGA-CONTRACTS-FOUNDATION with exact provenance. This is packaging readiness, not a passed pair or execution authority. Where the paired consumer BUILD supersedes the M0 archive, consume its actual new archive, rebuild this owner’s adapter/pins and rerun affected conformance before the pair. Preserve prior immutable archives; never substitute old qualifiedAgainst evidence for changed runtime bytes.

tasks.label: Bring the Auto Run + RightPanel integration suite to the store-driven RightPanel (continuation of MCOMP-01-02)
tasks.outcome: After MCOMP-01-02 removed the duplicated import, 28 of the 31 cases fail because RightPanel renders null: since the store migration it reads the active session from useSessionStore, rightPanelOpen / activeRightTab / activeFocus from useUIStore, rightPanelWidth / shortcuts / autoRunDisabled from useSettingsStore, the file tree from useFileExplorerStore and the document list from useBatchStore, while RightPanelTestWrapper still passes all of these as props to a component whose RightPanelProps no longer declare them, and its vi.mock calls name modules at their pre-move paths (components/AutoRunDocumentSelector, components/AutoRunnerHelpModal, hooks/useTemplateAutocomplete, components/FileExplorerPanel). Rewrite the wrapper to seed the five stores the way src/__tests__/renderer/components/RightPanel.test.tsx does (setState in beforeEach; the mode / cursor / scroll callbacks still observed through the props RightPanel keeps), move the mocks to the current module paths, and keep every one of the 31 cases: tab switching, panel resize, expanded-modal sync and focus management must each pass against the real RightPanel and AutoRun. Run under vitest.integration.config.ts (jsdom, --bail=0). Delete or skip no case. src/ is in the implementation tree, so repackage and re-pin after the commit. Keep 1 authored file and fewer than 500 changed lines.

tasks.label: Make the Symphony state file write whole under overlapping handler calls (continuation of MCOMP-01-02B, inserted ahead of it)
tasks.outcome: writeState() and writeCache() in shared.ts are a plain fs.writeFile, so two handler calls that overlap (symphony:updateStatus on the 5-second poll beside a symphony:registerActive, or the ten concurrent updates the integration suite fires) truncate and rewrite the same file and a reader lands on a document with trailing bytes of the longer write: after MCOMP-01-02B brought the Symphony integration suite to the current handlers, its concurrent-updates and atomic-write cases read "Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON" in two of three runs on 2026-10-29 and 79 passed in the third, so the suite is flaky on this defect alone. Route both writers through the canonical pair: atomicWriteJson() from src/main/utils/atomic-json-store.ts (a temp file then rename, 2-space output as today) inside a module-level createKeyedWriteQueue() keyed by the file path, because the writer uses one fixed <path>.tmp and two overlapping atomic writes would otherwise tear the temp file or lose the second rename to ENOENT. Serialize the write only; lost updates between overlapping read-modify-write calls stay as they are (both cases accept them, and queueing the whole read-modify-write is a separate decision), so change no handler. The handler unit suite mocks fs/promises with readFile, writeFile, mkdir, rm and access only: give the mock a rename, and move the assertions that find the state write by filtering fs.writeFile calls on symphony-state.json (near line 2374) or by reading mock.calls[0] (near 1163, 1313, 1342) to the <path>.tmp the atomic writer writes, or to the destination of rename. Run src/__tests__/main/ipc/handlers/symphony.test.ts under the default config and the integration suite under vitest.integration.config.ts (--bail=0) three times in a row; when every run reads 79 passed, check MCOMP-01-02B off as well, with a note naming this task. src/ is in the implementation tree, so repackage and re-pin after the commit. Keep 2 authored files and fewer than 500 changed lines.

tasks.label: Bring the Symphony integration suite to the current handlers (continuation of MCOMP-01-02)
tasks.outcome: After MCOMP-01-02 supplied the settings store and the fork helper gh calls, 18 of the 79 cases still fail against the current handlers, all of them expectation drift since the suite was last touched (e91d18a43, 2026-08-14). (1) getActive, getState and getStats drop contributions whose sessionId is absent from the sessions store (filterOrphanedContributions in dashboard.ts, fc64e4345) while the suite sessionsStore.get answers [], so the concurrent-contributions, recovery-after-restart, state-persistence, input-validation, concurrent-update, XSS, SQL-injection, contribution-id and atomic-write cases read an empty active list; feed the double the sessions the cases register (session-123, session-contrib_a and the rest) rather than removing the filter. (2) symphony:complete counts the streak by ISO week (lifecycle.ts getWeekNumber) while the year-boundary and timezone cases expect calendar-day increments; decide with the person which rule the product means, then make the cases assert that rule honestly (a week rule needs lastContributionDate seeded as a week key). (3) symphony:cloneRepo admits https://github.com/../../../etc/passwd because WHATWG URL parsing folds the .. segments into /etc/passwd before validateGitHubUrl sees it; the case expects a refusal, so either the validator refuses a raw URL containing .. or the case asserts the normalized slug the clone is held against; name the choice. (4) The external-document 404, redirect and large-content cases and the stats-overflow case fail on startContribution and stats paths not yet traced; trace each against the current contributionStart.ts and dashboard.ts and repair the fixture or the expectation, never the guard. Run under vitest.integration.config.ts (--bail=0); the suite must read 79 passed. Delete or skip no case. src/ is in the implementation tree, so repackage and re-pin after the commit. Extend the existing `electron.secondary-effects` case in `e2e/managed-full-journey.spec.ts` (its repository half is done) so the one case also holds: (a) a plugin act verb (`agents:dispatch` or `process:spawn`) of the seeded self-test plugin (`e2e/fixtures/plugin-harness.ts`, reuse its seeding, signing and consent helpers rather than a second harness) held by the managed plugin ceiling (`PermissionBroker.holds()`) on an enrolled desktop: fixture refuses it by name with nothing spawned or dispatched; endpoint admits the in-scope verb and refuses an out-of-scope one; (b) a browser relay effect (`navigate` or `read`) from an authenticated bridge client held by the browser ceiling (`browserEffectVerdict`): fixture refuses it by name (or the Live listener itself is held, which is also a refusal by name) and no page loads; endpoint admits the in-scope origin and refuses another. Each half records its facts in the case's one `effect` observation from disk, the plugin ledger or the endpoint calls, never from what the UI printed; endpoint mode fails by name on a missing input (extend `ManagedRunEndpointInputs` only with what the halves need), never skips. Read `Plans/integration-completion/EXECUTION-RULES.md`.
